title: How to style a widget you inject into someone else's page
problem: My widget ships as one script into markup I do not own, and the style tag it injects has no owner: mounting twice leaves two copies, and unmounting leaves the rules behind.
outcome: One labelled stylesheet per widget, added on mount, replaced rather than duplicated on remount, and removed by the same call that tears the widget down.

knowledge: A browser widget that mounts and unmounts itself from a page you do not control
